correctness.rationale: On N^2 vertices with exactly N uniformly occupied, H is the induced-edge count in the queen attack graph. Using the exact degree formula 4(N-1)-|i-j|-|i+j-(N-1)|, the edge total S=N(N-1)(5N-1)/3 and the incident-edge-pair total W have the claimed parity-polynomial forms, after evaluating the mixed |u^2-v^2| sum separately on integer and half-integer grids. For p_k=(N)_k/(N^2)_k the variance identity S p2+2W p3+2(binomial(S,2)-W)p4-(S p2)^2 proves both rational parity formulas, including N=2,3 with p_k=0 when k>N. Coefficient limit is 31/18. Differentiating the finite partition function yields the explicitly ordered T→∞ then N→∞ specific heat law. Independent exhaustive configurations N=2..5 (6,84,1820,53130 subsets) matched variances 0,26/63,2479/2275,4544/2277. No finite-T thermodynamic limit is proved.
